_note: Canned source pages for the PI-006 seeded-failure fixtures. The operator page carries currency figures ON PURPOSE: the rate-change fixture needs something for the detector to find. This file sits under next/scripts/, outside every lint root (src/content, src/data, src/pages, src/components, src/layouts), and the loop is tested to keep those figures out of its report.

Sorrento Winter Lantern Festival

After nineteen years, the 2026 Sorrento Winter Lantern Festival is cancelled. The committee lost its shire funding in June and will not run a lantern walk this year.

Sorrento Park will still host the winter solstice choir.
